# Vetta 0.6.19
<!-- release-status: released 2026-11-24 -->

## English

### New

- Right-click a file link in a reply to open it or show it in Finder (File Explorer on Windows). If the file has been moved or deleted, you'll see "File not found" instead of nothing happening. Not available for files in remote projects.

### Improvements

- The Usage ticket now shows your usage streak in days, your share on the top model, your peak hours and how many models you used, plus a list of your top 5 models with tokens and share. The ticket grows to fit the list.

## 中文

### 新增

- 回复里的文件链接可右键选择「打开」或「在访达中显示」（Windows 为资源管理器）；文件已被移走或删除时会提示「文件不存在」，不再点了没反应。远程项目的文件暂不支持。

### 改进

- 用量小票改为显示连续使用天数、主力占比、高峰时段和模型数，并新增前 5 个模型的列表（token 与占比），小票高度随模型数变化。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.18...v0.6.19
